title: Parking meter
description: A pixel parking meter: add 15 or 60 minutes with buttons (maximum 3 hours), show the paid time as h:mm and the price at 2.00 per hour to two decimals, and a Clear button.

title: Elevator panel
description: A pixel elevator panel for floors 1 to 6: press floor buttons to queue them, the car moves one floor per second toward the next queued floor, shows the current floor and direction, and opens its doors on arrival.

title: Color swap
description: A pixel puzzle on a 4x4 grid of colored tiles: click two adjacent tiles to swap them, count swaps, and show 'Solved!' when every row has a single color; a Shuffle button starts a new puzzle.

title: Invoice builder
description: A pixel invoice builder: add line items with a description, quantity and unit price, show each line total, the subtotal, a tax rate input in percent, the tax and the grand total to two decimals.

title: Interval trainer
description: A pixel interval trainer: set work seconds, rest seconds and rounds, Start counts down work then rest for each round, shows the phase and round number, and says 'Workout complete' at the end.

title: Library checkout
description: A pixel library desk: a list of 6 built-in books, each Available or Checked out, buttons to check out or return a book, a filter for available books only, and a count of checked-out books.

title: Weekly chart
description: A pixel bar chart of 7 days: an input per day for the hours slept (0 to 12), bars whose heights follow the values, the weekly average to one decimal, and the longest night highlighted.

title: Keypad lock
description: A pixel keypad lock with digits 0 to 9, Clear and Enter: the code is 4271, a correct code shows 'Unlocked', a wrong one shows 'Wrong code' and after 3 wrong tries the keypad locks for 10 seconds.
